status: proposed exact packet; not run approval
executable_binding: Every qualifying receipt must bind the exact validated executable E and its actual tested revision; later merge/main commits are distinct identities.
permitted_frozen_references: Repository blob at an immutable commit with committed SHA-256 of exact evidence bytes.
GitHub Release asset with committed SHA-256, byte length, provenance, independent read-back verification and public-content review.

For material barred from public publication: independently retained custody-approved private bytes with committed public digest and reviewed retention/provenance receipt; never an Actions-only private copy.
forbidden: A live Actions artifact, log URL, run listing or expiring download URL cannot be the only retrievable source of required frozen evidence. A committed digest alone does not preserve missing bytes.
actions_provenance: Original Actions run/job/attempt/artifact IDs and URLs remain source provenance only; frozen-package replay must not download from Actions.
archive_manifest_fields: logical evidence ID and case/gate contribution
workflow path/revision, source run/job/attempt and original conclusion
source artifact ID, name, creation/expiry and original service digest where present
archive Release tag/asset ID or immutable repository commit/blob
member inventory and per-member hashes where selected
public-content review hash or private custody designation
native verification result and source pins
seal_gate: All required evidence must have complete archival closure and read-back before package sealing or GO; any missing, mismatched, ambiguous or private-leaking item blocks sealing. Never substitute a component pass or fabricate a completed receipt.
source_retention: Explicit 90-day retention on selected upload steps is an ingestion buffer only, not final archival closure. Final new/admitted workflow packets must include that setting when uploading evidence.
unchanged_live_checks: Fresh authority/revocation/source/window/nonce checks at admission remain live and unchanged. This archive rule governs retained evidence, not permission to reuse expired authority.
historical_items: Use verified existing committed/Release copies for historical B06, INTCALC and POSTTRAN phase1. Do not rearchive or rerun merely because original Actions links expire. Graph-memory proposals are excluded unless explicitly selected.
invalidation: Any changed E or input must be reconciled under original provenance rules. Never relabel earlier evidence as testing a different executable.
verification_plan: Before sealing, resolve every manifest entry only through immutable repository blobs, Release assets or approved non-Actions private custody, with exact digest/size checks; deny Actions artifact/log downloads in this evidence replay. Preserve live admission checks separately.
authorization: No signing, key generation, nonce consumption, model call, merge, workflow activation or historical rerun is authorized by this policy packet.
